title: How the study of online collaborative learning can guide teachers and predict students' performance in a medical course
reason: Moodle forum interaction data (1251 posts) converted to per-student social-network indicators, correlated with and regressed on final, clinical and MCQ grades. Meets I1; reliability judgeable from extraction procedure and permutation tests.

extraction.design: correlational case study (SNA, Kendall tau-b, automatic linear regression, binary logistic regression)
extraction.n_quote: The course included 35 students with one instructor (36
extraction.population: medical students in a blended surgery course, 1 university
extraction.lms_indicators: Moodle forum interaction network: in-degree, out-degree, degree, betweenness, closeness, information and eigenvector centrality, eccentricity, clustering
extraction.outcome_or_construct: final course grade, OSCE (clinical) grade, MCQ grade; under-achiever (lowest third) status
